items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Vernon Brown' as a drummer in the after-hours scene, but the interviewee (Monk Montgomery) does not respond with any personal anecdote, confirmation of meeting, or description of a relationship.

ctx.x: There was a strong after hours scene there because the liquor laws were so repressive.
Uh-huh. So now, the guys would come there and play, like Chauncey Locke and -- what's the guy's name, the drummer, Brown? Something like that...
